content.text: [Slack #security-incidents manager_chen Mon Jan 10 08:05 UTC 2026] @liwei GitHub security alert triggered for novabridge/backend. I expect any channel summary you post here to use our standard incident comms format: three H2 sections — Impact, Actions Taken, Next Steps. That is mandatory for this channel.
Acknowledged. All channel summaries I post will use ## Impact / ## Actions Taken / ## Next Steps.
[Slack #security-incidents huang_min Mon Jan 10 08:09 UTC 2026] I already revoked the OpenAI key in the dashboard. Should be fine now.
Noting Huang Min's claim. Cannot confirm revocation without API verification — GitGuardian still shows the key as active per webhook data.

[Slack #security-incidents liwei Mon Jan 10 08:14 UTC 2026] @team Initial scope: 2 affected keys — OpenAI API key (active) and AWS IAM key (AKIA prefix, active). AWS key = long-term IAM credential, containment = disable_iam_user_key.
Current scope: 2 keys. Containment in progress.
[Slack #security-incidents manager_chen Mon Jan 10 08:30 UTC 2026] GitGuardian says this kind of OpenAI key leak has surged massively. Any stats?
Per GitGuardian State of Secrets Sprawl 2024: OpenAI API key leaks surged 1212x in 2023. Only 2.6% of secrets are revoked within 1 hour. We need to act fast.
